description: Moreton Bay Regional Council - Evacuation Centres (Open) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Community evacuation centres for the Moreton Bay Region ( moretonbay. qld. gov. au/evacuationcentres/ ) In the event of an emergency, it may be necessary to establish community evacuation centres. In some cases other means of evacuation or shelter may be more appropriate and residents will be advised accordingly. Coverage: City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. The portal files it under the publisher City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Its tags are disaster, disaster-management, evacuation-centre, mbrc. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
